newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet - private.

text.p: Trade in Nebraska feedlot cattle was at a standstill Friday with no bids or offers reported, market sources said.
"It is really quiet. Everyone is just sitting and waiting until Monday," one source said.
A slightly smaller showlist was expected next week, possibly falling to between 75,000 and 80,000 head versus 85,000 head this week.
Bids on Monday were expected to start out around $104 to $105 per cwt with owners pricing cattle at $108 and $109. Trade this week has been mostly at $106 and $107.
